A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the hippuridid lithosomes are not reefal, but are biostromal, and are not the result of the growth of a biostrome in a reefal environment.
the Santonian rudists of the southern Central Pyrennes were a gregarious sediment-inhabiting group, and that their biostromal growth fabric, with no supporting biogenic framework, was not reefal.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the term “reef” should only be applied to those biostromes which have grown in open marine environments and which have developed a substantial superstratal framework.
